attBesluta.text: After completing my DIY drywall job, this was a great tool for skim-coating the AP mixed with Muddskip. Would recommend for anyone trying to get wavy old home walls flat.
Also, der Flächenspachtel ist wirklich supi, sehr einfach zu bedienen, voll zufrieden, besten dank👍

Très bon rapport qualité prix. Je ne peux pas m'en servir, car je l'ai reçu avec la lame endommagé. J'attend le concours du SAV VEVOR qui va rapidement intervenir pour résoudre ce petit problème. C'est un produit très sérieux, ergonomique, robuste, pratique et léger. *****étoiles

Nice tool. Worked for my project. Great for diy. Or occasional professional use.

This skimmer is light and comfortable to use when skim coating drywall. The product is functional and easy to use, once you learn how to keep the blade parallel to the wall. The build quality, the blade in particular, is adequate but could be better. If the blade didn't bend so easily, I would rate this 5/5. Overall, a good value for the money.
Perfect addition to my fireplace and very well priced. Was easy to fit and works great.
Easy to put together, works well, Reasonably priced and delivered on time
livraison rapide, satisfait de ce produit esthétique facile a posé et a déposé pour ramonages.
